title: Lid-driven square cavity
description: Unit square, lid moves at U=1 in +x, incompressible laminar; Re = U L / nu with L=1. Compare u along the vertical centreline x=0.5 and v along the horizontal centreline y=0.5.

reference.citation: U. Ghia, K. N. Ghia, C. T. Shin, High-Re solutions for incompressible flow using the Navier-Stokes equations and a multigrid method, J. Comput. Phys. 48 (1982) 387-411, Tables I and II (129x129 grid). Values cross-checked against independent published copies of the tables (2 secondary sources; see docs/reference-data.md); v-centreline only at Re = 100.
reference.tolerance: 2 percent of lid speed for centreline profiles (F-028)
